content.summary: The court learns that the former student 阿倍朝臣仲麻呂 has died in Tang and grants funeral goods to his household in 寶龜十年五月 (779). The entry names no place; the record anchors the act at the court's seat, 平城宮, as a display anchor.

time.source_expression: 寶龜十年五月丙寅 前學生阿倍朝臣仲麻呂在唐而亡

content.editorial_notes: Coda node (outside the primary 750–754 mission window). The entry reports a death that happened in Tang; it gives no death date, so the chapter publishes the report's month and no death year.

places.note: The entry names no place. A court act happens at the court, whose seat in this period is 平城宮 (the palace of 平城京); the record anchors it there for map readability, not as a source-named site.

claims.statement: The chronicle records on 寶龜十年五月丙寅 that the former student 阿倍朝臣仲麻呂 died in Tang and that funeral goods were granted to his household.

locator.value: 卷第卅五 寶龜十年五月丙寅

citations.quoted_text: 丙寅。前學生阿倍朝臣仲麻呂在唐而亡。家口偏乏。葬礼有闕。勅賜東■一百疋。白綿三百屯。

claims.statement: The entry names 仲麻呂 as the deceased former student.
